entries.en:
Convinced of the merits of Qitarl Natl's argument, you express your support for his theory that his people were originally hunted by the Viis, a vote of confidence that pleases the Qitari steward greatly. Grudgingly agreeing that his father may have a point, the Qitari youngling Chaqurl Qhotl agrees to assist in the restoration of the second stela.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: Under your watchful eye, the Qitari artisans restore the second stela to Qitarl Natl's best interpretation of its former glory. Encouraged and heartened by reclaiming a vital piece of their legacy, the Stewards now pursue their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Continue to lend them your aid in their efforts should you so desire.
entries.fr: Les Qitari du plateau de Hopl célèbrent la restauration de la deuxième stèle légendaire. Mais les fouilles ne sont pas terminées pour autant !
entries.ja: ルリの発掘隊のキタリたちは、「第二の石碑」の復元完了を、とても喜んでいるようだ。これからも、キタリ族の発掘を手伝っていこう！

entries.en: History is full of cruelties and harsh truths. While my boy would propose a starry-eyed view of our past, I prefer to face reality with my eyes wide open.

entries.en: The Viis and Qitari forged a friendship trusted and true. Acknowledging the unpleasant nature of our first encounter allows us to appreciate that all the more. Surely you agree, ?

entries.fr: Sur deuxième stèle, Qitarl Natl penser que Qitari lever bras car avoir très peur. Viis nouuuvelles arrivantes dans forêt, croire que Qitari être animaux...
entries.ja:
「第二の石碑」は、キタリ族とヴィースたちの遭遇の記憶。
弓を構えた姿で描かれたヴィース族は、キタリを獲物と見たことで、
ロンカの敵となりかけたのでござろう。

entries.en: If you elect to vouch for Qitarl Natl's theory, the stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Chaqurl Qhotl envisions it.
entries.fr: Si vous choisissez de soutenir la théorie de Qitarl Natl, la stèle des Qitari sera restaurée selon cette hypothèse. Vous ne pourrez pas voir la version proposée par Chaqurl Qhotl.
entries.ja:
「キタルリ・ナトル」の説を信じてストーリーを進行させると、
彼の説に基づき、石碑の復元が行われるようです。
「チャクルリ・コテル」の説での復元結果を見ることはできません。

entries.en: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
entries.fr: Les récompenses que vous obtiendrez seront les mêmes dans les deux cas. Suivez donc vos convictions pour faire ce choix.

今後の友好部族デイリーのコンテンツ内容に、変化はありません。
あなたが語られるべきと思う歴史を、選択してください。

entries.en: Protected by the new altar erected according to the traditions of the Viis and heartened by rediscovering another piece of their heritage, the Stewards have returned to their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Should you choose, continue to aid them in their cause.
entries.fr: Les Qitari du plateau de Hopl, aidés par les Viis et leur connaissance des cérémonies de Ronka, redoublent d'efforts afin d'explorer la caverne de leurs ancêtres et d'y trouver tous les secrets qu'elle renferme.
entries.ja:
ルリの発掘隊のキタリたちは、ヴィースの知恵による祭壇と、
次なる石碑の姿に励まされ、一層発掘に打ち込んでいるようだ！
これからも発掘に協力し、洞窟遺跡での新たな発見に期待しよう！
